property_summary: Only the owner can cause the contract C's entire balance to be sent out (i.e., withdrawAll transfers out balance only when called by owner).
withdrawAll reverts for callers that are not the recorded owner (i.e., only the owner can successfully call withdrawAll).
Only the recorded owner can successfully withdraw the contract's entire balance (withdrawAll succeeds only when msg.sender == c.owner()).
If the caller is not c.owner(), then calling withdrawAll must revert (i.e., only the recorded owner can successfully withdraw the contract's balance).
If the provided caller is not the recorded owner, the call must have reverted.

For all callers and recipients, only the owner can successfully withdraw the contract balance (after calling withdrawAll the contract balance remains 0 only when called by owner); the mutant that removes the owner check allows non-owners to drain the balance, violating this property for some caller addresses.
Only the owner can cause the contract C to send its entire balance to an arbitrary recipient (i.e., withdrawAll succeeds only when msg.sender == owner).

When caller equals the contract owner, withdrawAll reverts exactly when the contract's balance is zero.
When the caller is the owner, withdrawAll reverts exactly when the contract balance is zero.
When caller is owner and invokes withdrawAll(recipient), the call reverts exactly when the contract's balance is zero.
